title: The Gathering sponsors
description: Machine-readable directory of The Gathering's sponsors. Source of truth for the sponsor cards on the public sponsorship page; render the page with scripts/gen-sponsor-cards.cjs. Recognition is non-exclusive: each sponsor declares its own focus and the directory lists them side by side.

sponsors.name: Digital Domain Technologies Ltd
sponsors.blurb: Founding sponsor of the MX community.

sponsors.name: Boye & Company
sponsors.blurb: Boye & Company, whose CMS Experts community brings together CMS vendors, agencies, and enterprise users across Europe and North America. Its founder, Janus Boye, wrote the foreword to MX: The Handbook and supports The Gathering in kind: a venue where the open drafts are read and tested by working practitioners, and an independent voice for the peer-consensus tradition that MX is built on.
